## Dashboards

- [Candy Dashboard](http://dhoinowski3.github.io/dashboards/candy.html): This dashboard is an analysis of data about various candies by companies. Comes from 538's Candy Rankings data from 2017.

- [Palmer Penguin Dashboard](http://dhoinowski3.github.io/dashboards/penguins.html): A dashboard concerning certain patterns and characteristics regarding penguins living in the Palmer Archipelago. Comes from the `palmerpenguins` package.
